verdict.rationale: Puzzle ships its own month-end close feature, AI Close, which uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies, and it documents bank and credit-card reconciliation. Nothing in the evidence describes a close checklist, tracking of accrual tasks, or reviewer sign-offs. missing for 10: a documented close checklist with task status tracking, accrual-entry tracking within the close, review/approval sign-off workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
